planSteps.description: Fill out 'Nombre' with 'TestSprite QA Org 2', 'Correo electrónico' with a random email ending in '@testsprite.test', and 'Contraseña' with 'Test1234!', then submit the form.
Click on the 'Soy una fundación' card
Fill out the organization onboarding form: Name 'TestSprite QA -- ignorar 2', Phone '3001234567', City 'Bogotá'. Submit the form.
Click the button to add a new volunteer. Fill name 'Voluntario de Prueba [TEST]', phone '3000000000', check availability for 'rescate', and save.
Verify 'Voluntario de Prueba [TEST]' appears in the volunteers list
Click the edit button for 'Voluntario de Prueba [TEST]', change the name to 'Voluntario Editado [TEST]', and save.
Verify the name is now 'Voluntario Editado [TEST]' in the list
Click the delete button for 'Voluntario Editado [TEST]' and confirm the deletion.
Verify 'Voluntario Editado [TEST]' no longer appears in the volunteers list
